title: "Set as Default" is dead on every saved view — `handleSetDefaultView` calls `updateView` unbound, so `this.connect()` throws before any request is issued
body:
Found by a **retest** of `records-forms.saved-view-management` (framework QA run objectstack-ai/objectstack#7439) against the console at pin `6314e87f2d49`. The fix under retest — #4139 / PR `b42558a4c` — **is verified working**; this is a separate, **pre-existing** defect on the same surface.

## Symptom

Clicking **Set as Default** on any saved view issues **zero network requests**. The console logs:

```
[ViewTabBar] Failed to set default view: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'connect')
```

and shows a toast *"Failed to set default view"*. The view never gains `isDefault`, and the prior defaults are untouched. Reproduced **3×** — on a draft-addressed view, on a published view, and in a repeat focused run.

## Reproduction

1. As the seeded admin, open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task`.
2. Create any saved view via the `+` tab (`data-testid=view-tab-add`) — e.g. a kanban, machine key `rt5_board`.
3. Open that tab's actions menu (`data-testid=view-tab-actions-showcase_task.rt5_board`).
4. Click **Set as Default** (`data-testid=view-tab-menu-default-showcase_task.rt5_board`).

**Expected**: a `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/<name>` setting `isDefault:true` (plus PUTs unsetting the prior default); the view is default after reload.
**Actual**: no requests at all; the console error above; server state unchanged.

## Root cause

`packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` — `handleSetDefaultView` does:

```ts
const updateView = (dataSource as any).updateView;
…
updateView(objectName, /* … */);   // called UNBOUND
```

`this` is therefore `undefined` inside the adapter method, whose first statement is `await this.connect()`.

The cleanest confirmation is the sibling: **`handlePinView` calls `(dataSource as any).updateView(...)` as a method and works** — which is exactly why rename and pin pass in the same menu while set-default does not.

**`handleReorderViews` in the same file repeats the identical unbound-call pattern** and is presumably broken the same way (not exercised in this run).

## Not a regression from #4139

Verified by reading the call site at `b42558a4c^` (the commit *before* the #4139 fix): the same `const updateView = (dataSource as any).updateView` call was already there, and `updateView` already began with `await this.connect()`. This is pre-existing.

## Secondary defect on the same surface (lower severity)

**`deleteView` was not taught the draft qualifier that `updateView` gained in #4139.** Deleting a view that exists only as a *draft* issues `DELETE /api/v1/meta/view/<name>` against the published overlay and returns `200 {"success":true,"reset":false,"message":"No view '<name>' found — nothing to delete."}` — while the draft survives and the tab is still present after reload. Worth closing in the same pass.

## What is verified working (so this card is narrowly scoped)

- **#4139 itself is fixed**: `updateView` on a draft-only view now writes the full merged item to `?mode=draft` (200, `seq` advancing) with the kanban config intact — no create-equivalent flattening, no lost config. Rename and pin both round-trip on a draft and survive reload.
- Create (draft → publish → live) works; delete on a *published* view works (`reset:true`, tab gone after reload).
- Non-admin gating is correct: no `view-tab-add` / `view-tab-actions-*` in the DOM for a real second persona, and forged `PUT`/`DELETE` on `/api/v1/meta/view/*` answer **403** (`manage_metadata` required) with nothing persisted.

## Source

Retest of `records-forms.saved-view-management` at console pin `6314e87f2d49`, framework `b602d536`. The `set-default` failure blocks the item's clause 1 and makes its "two views flagged default" negative unexercisable.
